mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.username, u.nickname, a.username AS admin_name FROM punishment p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user a ON p.admin_id = a.user_id WHERE p.punish_id = #{punishId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO punishment (user_id, type, reason, start_time, end_time, status, admin_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{reason}, NOW(), #{endTime}, 1, #{adminId})
mapper.update: UPDATE punishment SET status = 2 WHERE punish_id = #{punishId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM punishment WHERE status = 1
